tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i rab tu byed pa bstan pa'i nor rdzas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

swā sti/ las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i rab tu byed pa bstan pa'i nor rdzas zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa mchog gi zhabs rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs kyi bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan zab gsal gnyis med dkyil 'khor las/ /ma lus rigs kyi sprul pa'i tshogs spro ba/ /bde stong mkha' la ye shes 'od ris shar/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir ni las dang po la nyer mkho ba/ /cung zad bdag gis rnam par dbye 'dod na/ /shes ldan rnams kyis sngon med nyung ngu'i gtam/ /'gro la phan pa'i rgyu ru mnyan pa'i rigs/ /sdom ni/ rgyud kyi rang bzhin de don sgom tshul dang*/ /rgyud rnams bshad pa'i man ngag ces bya'o/ /'dir rdo rje'i theg pa'i don ni 'di tsam ste/ rgyud rnams kyi rang bzhin dang*/ de'i don sgom tshul dang*/ rgyud bshad thabs te gsum po 'di dag go/de la rgyud ces bya ba ni sngags rnams dang de'i cho ga'o/ / de ston par byed pa'i bka'i tshogs la yang rdo rje theg pa'i sde snod dang rgyud ces bya'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod dang*/ sngags kyi sde snod dang*/ chos 'di pa rnams kyi rgyud dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i sde snaud ces pa rnams grangs so/ /rdo rje theg pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes pa yang rnam grangs so/ /ci sngags dang rgyud so so'i skye bos byas pa dag yod dam/ yod de/ phyugs bdag gis byas pa dang*/ drang srong gis byas pa dang*/ lha dang 'byung po dang*/ gsang ba pa dag dang*/ sngags mkhan dag gis byas pa dag yin te/ de dag ni rdo rje theg pa dang*/ sngags kyi sde snod ni ma yin te/ gzhan du sngags dang rgyud ces bya'o/ /yong ye sngags kyi theg pa zhes bya ba ni ji zhig dbye ba ni gang dngos dang ming gis btags pa'i khyad par ni ci zhe na/ rig sngags kyi sbyor ba gco bor ston pa'i lam dang*/

de'i 'bras bu ni sngags kyi theg pa'o/ /de yang rnam par dbye na/ 'jig rten pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa'o/ /'jig rten pa'i theg pa gang zhe na/ 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ de dag gi lam dang*/ gzugs med pa'i khams su skye ba gzhan la sngags kyi sbyor bas bgrod par byed pa'i lam rnams so/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa gang zhe na/ theg pa gsum po dag go /'jig rten pa'i theg pa ni ming tsam ste/ go 'phang mi g.yo ba ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ de la nges par 'jug pa ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ yul dus nye tshe ba'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i ni dngos te/ rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /de'i yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni gtso bo ma yin no/ gang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod 'dir 'jig rten pa'i sbyor ba de dag 'jig rten pa'i theg pa zhes bya'am zhe na de ltar yin te/ 'jig rten pa'i theg pa la dngos btags kyis dbye na/ slar yang 'jig rten pa'i theg pa yang rnam pa gsum ste/ 'jig rten pa nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ nges pa la 'jug pa'i 'jig rten pa dang*/ sems kyi rten 'jig rten pa'o/ /dang po ni so so'i skye bos byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las 'byung ba 'jig rten pa'i theg pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ tshogs kyi lam dang*/ sbyor ba'i lam mo/ /de la phyi ma gnyis ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sder gtogs te/ de ston par byed pa rnams kyang de'i sde snod du gtogs so/ /'phags pa'i sems can gyis rang dgar byas pa yang*/ de'i sder gtogs mod kyi/ 'on kyang sde snod ni ma yin no/ /bar sdom ni/ ngo bo rnam grangs 'jig rten pa'i/ /rgyud dang sngags kyi theg pa yi/ /rang bzhin dbye ba dngos btags khyad/ /'jig rten pa yi dbye ba'o/ /rgyud kyi ngo bo dang*/ rnam grangs dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i rgyud dang*/

sngags kyi theg pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i theg pa'i dbye ba'o/ /'di la mdo dang rgyud ni ci zhe na/ 'dir mdo ni gcig las 'phros pa la sogs pa phal cher dag go /rgyud ni mkha' lding gi sbyor ba la sogs pa'o/ /mdo yang yin la rgyud kyang yin pa ni/ sngags kyi sde snod de rnams so/ /gnyis ka ma yin pa ni rtog ge la sogs pa'o/ /rgyu'i theg pa dang 'bras bu'i theg pa'i khyad par gang zhe na/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa zhes bya ba lha'i rnal 'byor gyi khyad par ro/ /pha rol du phyin pa'i tshul dang*/ sngags kyi tshul gyi khyad par gang zhe na/ sngags dang sbyor ba gtso bor ston pa dang*/ ma yin pa'i khyad par ro/ /ci'i phyir sngags kyi tshul mchog tu gyur pa yin/ sngags kyi tshul rnams ni du zhe na/ las dang po la thabs su gyur pa ste/ myur ba dang*/ bde ba dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /ji ltar myur ba yin zhe na/ skye ba 'di'am/ skye ba bcu drug gam/ bskal pa gsum mam/ bskal pa brgyad kyi byang chub thob pa'o/ /rgyu cis myur ba yin zhe na/ cho ga'i khyad par gyis lha rnams dngos su mchod pa len pas yongs su spyad pa las byung pa'i bsod nams yod pa dang/ sngags kyi mthus chu thigs pa gcig la yang gaṅgā'i bye snyed kyi bsod nams 'byung ba dang*/ las dang po pas ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gog pa'i zhing sbyong ba'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du byed pa dang*/ sngags sam ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par re res kyang sems can rnams smin pa'i rgyu khyad par can 'di dag theg pa la zhugs pa tsam la yang yod pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyis gzugs bden pa gnyis ka'i tshul gyis 'bras bu'i rnam pa la dmigs pa'i shes rab rnams dang po dang tha ma'i bar du yod pas na'o/ /ji ltar na bde ba yin zhe na/ lus dang sems la tshor ba rtsub po med pa nyid do/ /rgyu cis bde ba yin zhe na/

'di la bskal pa drug dang ldan pa'i lus dang grub pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dang ting nge 'dzin mang po thob pa dang*/ sngags kyi mthus sangs rgyas rnams mngon sum du bzhugs pa dang*/ sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor bas 'gro ba'i bsam pa thams cad bsgrubs pas na'o/ /thabasas la mkhas pa gang zhe na /tshul khrims dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab dang*/ spyod yul la 'jug pa rnams kyi'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ tshul khrims : mnyam [ma nyams ] pas lha dges pa dang*/ spyod yul khyad par can dang 'brel pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab dang*/ gzhan dag ni theg pa chen po tshul nyid kyi bslab pa gsum dang*/ spyod yul thams cad du lha dang sngags kyi thabs yod do/ /bya ba'i rgyud chen po'am/ spyod pa'i rgyud dam/ gnyis ka'i rgyud ces bya ba 'di lha'i bsnyems pa rgyas pa'i tshul gyis 'jug go /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la ni lha'i bsnyems pa khyab pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa'o/ /rnal 'byor bla na med par ni bde ba'i sdom pa tshul khrims dang*/ bag chags dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ gong ma'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ bde ba khyab pa dang*/ spyod yul de nyid la dmigs pa'i shes rab dang*/ snying rje chen po dang*/ mnyam pa nyid dang*/ rang bzhin med pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ lha'i rnam pas khyab pa dang*/ des de dag nyid mchog la sbyor bas spyod yul la 'jug go /tshul khrims ni thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ rgya che ba dang*/ zab pa'i khyad par dang ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab kyang thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ rgya che ba dang*/ zab pa'i khyad par ro/ /ci'i phyir bde ba chen pos myur zhe na/ bde ba ni snying rje'i rang bzhin/ de nyid rang bzhin med cing*/ dmigs pa med par mngon sum mam/ mngon sum gyi tshul gyis las dang po bas bskyed pas/ bde bas stong pa phul du 'gyur ba mngon sum gyi rnam pa dang*/ des kyang bsod nams phul du phyin par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/

/bar bsdom ni/ rgyud dang 'bras dang sngags kyi khyad/ /myur bde thabs mkhas rnams kyis mchog /myur dang bde la ji ltar rgyu/ /yongs spyad 'phel dang sbyong dang smin/ /shes rab kyis myur lus ting 'dzin/ /mngon sum bzhugs dang bsam pa sgrub/ /bslab gsum spyod yul bla med la/ /thun mong min dang rgya che zab/ 'dir sngags kyi tshul ni gsum ste/ mchog dang dman pa dang yan lag go /de'i ngo bo gang zhe na/ bde ba chen po dang*/ lha'i bsnyems pa dang*/ sngags dang sbyor ba tsam dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po gnyis ni dngos dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ sdom pa dang 'brel ba yin no/ /phyi ma ni rnams ma yin te gzhan du na/ sngags pa zhes pa tsam mo/ /yang sngags kyi tshul bdun te/ gtan du ba'i lam dang*/ cha shas can dang*/ khyad par du gyur pa dang*/ dang por bden pa dang*/ phal cher bde chen gyi tshul dang*/ 'ga' zhig bde chen dang*/ cung zad bde chen gyi tshul lo/ /'dir thams cad bde chen zhes bya ba yod mod kyi/ de ni gtan du ba'i lam nyid du 'gyur ro/ /bar sdom ni/ gsum la dbye ba ngo bo dang*/ khyad par dang ni tshul bdun no/ /sngon chad kha ba can 'dir ni/ /sngags par smra ba shas ches kyang*/ 'di ni ma rtogs 'di rtogs pa/ bla ma rnams kyi drin nyid de/ /tshul 'di ji bzhin ma shes pas/ /mdo rgyud khyad par mkhas pas kyang*/ /rnam pa kun tu ma phyed cing*/ /'phags pa rnams kyi gtam 'di yin/ zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de la rgyud dang sngags ni rnam par dbye bar bya ste/ de la sngags gang zhe na/ gsang sngags rnams dang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes so/ /rgyud gang zhe na/ de'i sbyor ba ste/ las dang dngos grub kyi tshogs rnams so/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi rim par phye ba ste dang po'o/ /de la de nyid rnam par bshad par bya ste/ rgyu'i rgyud dang*/ thabs kyi rgyud dang*/

'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /de skad du yang*/ rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya ba ste/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /gzhi dang ngo bo rang bzhin dang*/ /mi 'phraugs pa yi rab phye ba/ zhes pa 'di ni re zhig lung ngo*/ /ngo bo gtso bo mtshan nyid dang*/ / rnam grangs ldan pa gnas skabs dang*/ /mi 'gyur bas kyang rgyu rgyud bsdus/ / rgyu'i rgyud gang zhe na/ thog ma med pa'i dus rnams nas rgyud de 'ongs pa/ sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba gang yin pa dang*/ sems dang sems las byung ba rnams dang*/ snod dang bcud kyi rang bzhin dang*/ rtsa dang rlung dang*/ khams dang*/ chos kyi dbyings gang yin pa de rnams so/ /de rnams kyi gtso bo ni sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /de nyid gang zhe na/ zhing dang*/ sku dang*/ ye shes la sogs pa 'bras bu'i chos mthun pa'i khyad par can/ rang bzhin bde ba chen po rgyun chad pa med pa/ chos nyid kyis thob pa ste khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /rgyu'i rgyud dang*/ sbyang gzhi dang*/ kun gzhi dang*/ dang po'i sangs rgyas ni rnam grangs so/ /rgyu ni du/ gzhi ni du/ kun gzhi ni du/ dang po'i sangs rgyas ni du zhe na/ rgyu ni bcu bzhi ste/ nyon mongs pa'i rgyu dang*/ las kyi rgyu dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi stai kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dang*/ snod dang*/ bcud dang*/ lam gyi rgyu dang*/ stong pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ zung du 'jug pa'i rgyu dang*/ rags pa dang*/ phra ba dang*/ shin tu phra ba'i rgyu dang*/ gzugs kyi sku gnyis dang*/ chos kyi sku'i rgyu rnams so/ /gzhi ni bco lnga ste/ snod dag pa'i gzhi dang*/ bcud dag pa'i gzhi dang*/ nyer spyod dag pa'i gzhi dang*/ rnam par 'gyur ba dag pa'i gzhi dang*/ rang bzhin dag pa'i gzhi dang*/ 'khor ba'i gzhi dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i gzhi dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gzhi dang*/ rnam grangs kyi gzhi dang*/ mthar gtugs pa'i gzhi dang*/ kun rdzob kyi gzhi dang*/ don dam pa'i gzhi dang*/

rags pa'i gzhi dang*/ phra ba'i gzhi dang*/ shin tu phra ba'i gzhi rnams so/ /dang po lnga ni las dang bya ba'i sgo nas te/ sbyang bya'i rab tu dbye ba'o/ /de nas gsum ni bcings grol gyi rab tu dbye ba'o/ /de nas gnyis gnyis ni dngos dang btags pa ba dang*/ rdzas dang btags pa'i rab tu phye ba'o/ /tha mar gsum ni rtogs tshul gyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /de la rags pa'i gzhi gang zhe na/ dgu po 'di dag ste/ gang zag tu btags pas yod pa dag la brjod de/ tsan dan dang*/ ut+pal dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ pad+ma dmar po dang*/ rin po che lta bu dang*/ nyon mongs pas rnam par phye ba dang*/ las kyi rnam par phye ba dang*/ lus kyi rnam par phye ba dang*/ rigs kyi rnam par phye ba'o/ /dang po lnga ni mtshan nyid kyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /phyi ma bzhi ni rnam grangs kyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /'dir kun gzhi zhes bya ba ni/ sde snod kyi tshul las 'byung ba kho na bzhin no/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas ni gnyis te/ rang bzhin gyi dang po dang*/ glo bur gyi dang po'i sangs rgyas so/ /'di la ji ltar na skyon dang yon tan dang*/ rgyu dang 'bras bu dag dang 'brel bar ldan zhe na/ sad pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs dang*/ gnyid stug gi gnas skabs dang*/ bzhi pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgrib pa zhes bya ba gnas te/ dga' ba bzhi'am snang ba bzhi dang lhan cig gnas pa yin no/ /rlung bzhi dang*/ thig le bzhi dang*/ 'khor lo bzhi las dri bcas dang*/ cung zad dri bral dang*/ chos dri bral lam/ 'dzag bcas kyi dbang dang*/ 'dzag med kyi dbang dang*/ shin tu 'dzag pa dang bral ba'i dbang las rigs bzhi dang*/ rgyud bzhi dang*/ 'gro ba bzhi dang*/ yon tan bzhi dang*/ thun tshod bzhi dang*/ bag chags bzhis rnam par rtog pa bzhi 'byung ste/ thams cad yod par rtog pa dang*/ rdul phran du rtog pa dang*/ sems tsam du rtog pa dang*/ de yang mi dmigs pa ste/ grub mtha' bzhi dang*/ sde pa bzhi dang*/

skad cig ma bzhi dang*/ dga' ba bzhi dang*/ bden pa bzhi la sgro 'dogs pa'am de dag la ji bzhin du rtogs pa ste/ de bzhin du e waṃ ma yā dang*/ gnas bzhi dang*/ rigs bzhi'i phyag rgyas dri ma sbyong ba'i khyad par dang*/ sku bzhi dang*/ rdo rje bzhi la sogs pa ji ltar rgyud las rgyas pas 'byung ba de ltar shes par bya'o/ /'dir gnas skabs gang zhe na/ thar pa'i cha mthun ma bskyed pa dang*/ bskyed pa dang*/ so so'i skye bo'i lam dang*/ slob pa'i lam dang*/ mi slob pa rnams su dang po'i sangs rgyas dang*/ rgyu'i rgyud dang*/ lam du zhugs pa dang*/ 'phags pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes ming gis btags so/ /de rnams su 'gyur ba med pa ji lta bu zhe na/ snga ma las phyi ma'i tshe ngo bo mi 'gyur ba ste skye ba dang*/ rga ba dang*/ na ba dang*/ 'chi ba dang*/ 'gro ba rnams dang*/ rten 'brel rnams dang*/ rigs pa dang*/ bden pa mthong ba dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa la zhugs pa dang*/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis kyang mi 'jig cing mi 'gyur ba'o/ /thabs kyi rgyud gang zhe na/ sdom ni/ dbang bskur dam tshig sdom pa dang*/ /ting nge 'dzin rgyud kyi sbyor ba'o/ /lnga po 'di dag ni thabs kyi rgyud de/ /dbang bskur ba dang*/ dam tshig rnams dang*/ sdom pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ las dang dngos grub kyi sbyor ba'o/ dbang bskur ba gang zhe na/ bum pa dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ bzhi pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ slob ma'i dbang dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa dang*/ tha mal gyi dbang dang*/ mchog gi dbang dang*/ 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes su gnang ba dang*/ lung bstan pa dang*/ gzengs bstod pa dang*/ yon dbul ba dang bcas pa rnams so/ /dam tshig gang zhe na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang*/ sgrub pa'i dam tshig go /bsrung ba'i dam tshig gang zhe na/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang*/

yan lag gi ltung ba la sogs pa bsrung ba nyid do/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba gang zhe na/ bcu bzhi po rnams so/ /yan lag gi ltung ba gang zhe na brgyad dam dgu po rnams so/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing*/ bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /spun la smad par mi bya zhing*/ /sems can rnams la byams mi spangs/ /byang chub sems ni dor mi bya/ /rang gzhan chos la smad mi bya/ /ma smin pa la gsang mi sgrag /phung po rnams la smad mi bya/ /dag pa'i chos la som nyi spangs/ /gdug pa can la byams pa spangs/ / ming sogs bral la der mi rtog /dad ldan sems ni sun mi dbyung*/ /dam tshig spong dang bud med smod/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes brjod do/ /'di dag mi shes mi rung bas/ /sngon gyi mkhan po'i lung las shes/ /zhes pa ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /sgrib pa'i dam tshig gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ spyod lam dang*/ bza' ba'i dam tshig dang*/ mi 'bral bar yo byad kyi dam tshig go /rigs lnga po rnams kyi dam tshig gang yin pa de rnams ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dam tshig go / gzhan yang dam tshig ni gsum ste las dang po pa dang*/ brtan pa thob pa dang*/ brtan pa cher thob pa'i dam tshig rnams so/ /yang dam tshig ni gsum ste/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig go/ yang gsum ste bum dbang gi dam tshig dang*/ gsang dbang gi dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dam tshig go /gzhan yang bsnyen pa'i dam tshig dang*/ 'jig rten pa so so'i sgrub pa'i dang*/ las so so'i dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub pa'i dang*/ sgrub pa chen po'i dam tshig go /de la dam tshig ces bya ba ni brtul zhugs so/ /sdom pa ni/ thob par byed pa'i cho ga dang*/ thob pa'i dus dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ gtong ba'i dus dang*/ gso ba'i cho ga sde drug po de dag go /sdom ni cho ga dus dang ngo bo dbye/ /gtong dus gso ba'i thabs rnams so/ /de la sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma bshad pa'i cho ga las ni sdom pa med de brtul zhugs tsam mo/

/de'i phyir cho ga ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las bshad pa'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /dus ni dbang so so'i dngos gzhi rdzogs pa na'o/ /ngo bo ni byin gyis brlabs pa'i sems kyi rgyun gyi khyad par nyes pa rnams bzlog par byed pa yon tan gyi rten mthu brtas pa'am/ dbye ba ni thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa'o/ /thun mong gi sdom pa gang zhe na/ bya ba dang rnal 'byor phyi'i sdom pa'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa gang zhe na/ bde bas byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ slob ma dang*/ bum pa dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi sdom pa rnams so/ /de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis gnyis su rtogs par bya'o/ /'jig rten pa rnams kyang phal cher 'dod pas bsdus so/ /gzugs dang gzugs med pas bsdus pa dag kyang yod do/ /gtong ba'i dus ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba dag 'byung ba dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa spong ba de'i tshe'o/ /cha shas cha shas ni rang rang gi rtsa ba'i dam tshig las 'das pa na'o/ /gso ba'i cho ga ni sdig pa yongs su sbyangs nas slar yang blang ba yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa dang mtshan ma med pa'o/ /de yang bya ba'i rgyud du ni/ bdag gi de nyid dang*/ lha'i de nyid dang*/ bzlas brjod kyi de nyid dang*/ bsam gtan gyi de nyid do/ /bdag gi de nyid dang*/ bsam gtan gyi de nyid ni mtshan ma med par gtogs so/ /bar pa gnyis ni mtshan ma can du gtogs so/ /lha drug ni/ stong dang yi ge sgra gzugs dang*/ /phyag rgya mtshan ma drug tu 'dod/ /bzlas brjod ni gsum ste/ sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol/ /gsang sngags mi 'gyur gzhi la gnas/ /yan lag ma nyams gsang sngags bzlas/ /ngal na bdag la ngal gso zhig /bsam gtan ni/ gsang sngags mer gnas dngos grub ster/ /sgrar gnas rnal 'byor ster bar byed/ /sgra mtha'i thar pa sbyin par byed/ /ces 'byung ngo*/

/spros pas chog go /'dir ni bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de gnyis sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ sgra don dang*/ grangs dang*/ go rim nges pa ni sngon gyi mkhan po dag gis bshad pa dang*/ gzhan du smra bar 'dod do/ /'dir re re yang ngo bo dang*/ yan lag dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ gnas skabs dang*/ dngos dang btags pa'i khyad par ro/ /bskyed pa'i ngo bo gang zhe na/ rnam par rtog pas gsar du bsgom pa las byung ba'i lha sku'i rnam pa can srid pa gsum dang chos mthun du bsgom pa'i zhu bde'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /yan lag gang zhe na/ mthun mtshams sam mchod pa dang bstod pa la sogs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /ci'i phyir yan lag ces bya zhe na/ rang gi ngo bo'i srid pa dang 'bras bu'i rnam pa la lam du mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye ba gang zhe na/ dang po sbyor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ las rgyal mchog dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ nyer bsgrub dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ sgrub chen dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po rnams so/ /gnas skabs gang zhe na/ las dang po pa dang*/ ye shes phebs pa dang*/ ye shes la dbang ba dang*/ ye shes la ches dbang ba rnams so/ /dngos ni yan lag bdun dang ldan pa yin la gzhan rnams ni btags pa'o/ /bskyed rim gyi dpyad pa'i gnas drug gang zhe na/ smras pa/ sbyang gzhi gang yin mthar thug 'bras bu gang*/ /rdzogs rim gang yin smin byed dgos pa gang*/ /ngo bo gang yin mthar phyin tshad gang yin/ /dpyad pa'i gnas drug yan lag kun la sbyar/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang zhe na/ sdom ni/ ngo bo dbye ba so so yi/ /rang bzhin dang ni dpyad pa'i gnad/ /ngo bo gang zhe na/ sems dang yid dang rlung dbu mar thim pas/ mngon du gyur pa'i bde stong ngo*/ /dbye ba gang zhe na/ dngos dang*/ btags pa dang/ mtshan ma can dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/

khyab byed dang*/ khyab bya rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de la thog ma gnyis ni rang bzhin gyi dbye ba'o/ /tha ma gnyis ni tha snyad kyis phye ba'o/ /bar ba gnyis ni rnam pas rab tu phye ba'o/ /de rnams nyid kyi rang bzhin gang zhe na/ de yang zhu ba'i bde ba lhan skyes chen po dang*/ sgyu ma'i sku dang*/ rang bzhin lhan skyes dang*/ zung 'jug gi sku dang*/ rlung dbu mar thim pa'i mthar thob pa kun nas nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam par byang ba snang ba gsum dang*/ dga' ba gsum dang*/ de rnams dngos su 'thob pa'i lam gang yin pa de rnams rdzogs pa'i rim pa dngos zhes bya'o/ /btags pa gang zhe na/ rtsa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rlung dang*/ phra mo dang*/ thig le dang*/ phyag rgya'i rim pa rlung dbu mar 'jug pa dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ thim par byed pa'i las can rnams so/ /mtshan ma'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang zhe na/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan ma dang*/ btags pa'i mtshan ma can no/ /ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan ma gang zhe na/ snang ba gsum sems dang sems las byung ba'i mtshan nyid can 'od gsal bar gnas yongs su ma gyur pa ste so so'i skye bo thams cad dang gzhan la yang yod do/ /btags pa'i mtshan ma gang zhe na/ sgra don can gyi rtog pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa gang yin pa ste/ don gyi 'od gsal ma thob pa'i bar dag tu ci rigs par yod do/ /mtshan ma med pa gang zhe na/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan ma med pa dang*/ btags pa'i mtshan ma med pa ste/ dang po ni 'phags pa kho na la yod do/ /phyi ma ni so so'i skye bo la yang yod do/ /khyab byed rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang zhe na/ so sor sdud pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ srog rtsol dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ rjes su dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ dga' ba bzhi dang*/ snang ba dang*/ snang ba mched pa dang*/ snang ba nye bar thob pa dang*/ 'od gsal ba dang snang phyogs dang*/ stong phyogs dang*/ bde ba'i phyogs dang*/ phyogs dang bral ba rnams so/ /de la dang po drug ni yan lag gi rab tu phye ba dang*/

de nas brgyad ni ngo bo nyid dang*/ de nas gsum ni rnam pa dang*/ tha ma ni rang bzhin gyis rab tu phye ba'am/ yang na bzhi ga'ang rnam pas rab tu phye ba'o/ ci'i phyir khyab byed ces bya zhe na/ gang rdzogs pa'i rim pa de thams cad la khyab pa'i phyir ro/ khyab bya gang zhe na/ lus rnam par dben pa dang*/ ngag dben pa dang*/ sems dben pa dang*/ bdag byin rlabs pa dang*/ 'od gsal ba dang*/ zung 'jug dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ bdag byin rlabs pa dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ nor bu 'gengs pa dang*/ dza lan+dha ra dang*/ bsam mi khyab dang*/ rang byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang*/ rgyud kyi rim pa dang*/ sngags dang ye shes dang*/ gsang ba'i rim pa dang*/ so sor sdud pa la sogs pa yang 'ga' zhig tu yod de/ gzhan yang sngags dang*/ dbyibs dang*/ chos dang*/ rtsa dang*/ rlung dang*/ thig le dang*/ me dang*/ las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ ye shes dang*/ dam tshig dang*/ phyag rgya chen po dang*/ snying ga'i thig le dang*/ nor bu dang*/ sprul pa dang*/ mi shigs pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ de dag la sogs pa dpag tu med pa dag go /dpyad pa'i gnad rnams gang zhe na/ smras pa/ ngo bo gang yin gang la gnad du bsnun/ /ji ltar gnad bsnun de yi nyams rtags gang*/ /yon tan gang bskyed de yi rgyu mtshan gang*/ /dngos brgyud spangs bya gang spong mthar phyin tshad/ /sa dang lam gyi mtshams gang gegs sel dang*/ /bogs 'don ci zhig gtso 'khor khyad gang yin/ /dpyad pa'i gnas bcu gcig gi sgo nas dpyad/ /rdzogs rim rim pa kun gyi gnad shes 'gyur/ /gang la gnad du bsnun pa lus kyi rnam par bzhag pa gang zhe na/ lus chags pa dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ 'jig pa'i tshul lo/ /brjod pa/ ba spu'i bu ga'i grangs nyid kyi/ /rtsa ni bye ba phyed dang bzhi/ /de las stong phrag bdun cu gnyis/ /de las brgyad cu gnyis lhag brgya/ /de bzhin brgya dang nyi shu dang*/

/sum cu gnyis dang rtsa gsum mo/ /bskyed dang bsdud pa thams cad kyi/ /gnas ni snying ga yin pa'i phyir/ /grub pa rnams dang mkhas rnams kyi/ /snying ga kho na bsngags pa yin/ khams kyang so gnyis bcu drug dang*/ /khu khrag 'khor lo gnas tshul dang*/ dkar dmar 'phel 'grib 'pho ba'i 'gros/ /rlung yang nyi khri chig stong dang*/ drug brgya brgyad lhag brgya dag las/ /bcu ni rnam par shes par bya/ /re re yang ni gnas dang grangs/ /rgyu tshul kha dog mgon po dang*/ /lha mo rnams kyi dbye ba dang*/ /'jug gnas 'byung dang 'pho tshul lo/ /phung khams dbang yul ye shes lnga*/ /nyer lnga phra dang rags pa'i tshul/ /sems de'i bzhon par gyur pa ni/ /rlung yang phra rags rnam gsum mo/ /ji ltar gnad du bsnun zhe na/ /yul gyi gnad dang*/ dus dang/ lus dang*/ rlung dang*/ dmigs pa'i gnad do/ /dmigs pa'i gnad kyang*/ gang la sems 'jog pa dang*/ rlung sdud tshul dang*/ dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par te/ bzhi po de dag gis yon tan mngon du byed cing*/ dri ma rnams sbyong bar byed do/ /sa dang lam gyi mtshams gang zhe na/ lam ni lnga ste/ tshogs dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ mthong ba dang*/ sgom pa dang*/ mi slob pa'i lam mo/ /ye shes phebs pa ni tshogs lam chung ngu ste dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'o/ /ye shes la ches dbang ba ni yang dag spong ba ste tshogs kyi lam 'bring po'o/ /de nyid spyod pas mthar phyin cing lta stangs rnams thogs pa med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams mngon du 'gyur pa dang*/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa 'di ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa can/ tshogs lam chen po'o/ /rdzogs rim dngos kyi sems dben pa thob pa zhu ba'i bde ba mthar thug pa dbang po lnga'i rang bzhin drod dang rtse mo zhes bya la/ ye shes kyi sku ni nam mkha' mdzod thob pa stobs lnga dang ldan pa bzod pa dang chos mchog go /'dir rtsa dang*/ rlung dang*/ thig le thim pa'i ye shes yon tan gyi gzhir gyur pa gong ma'i lam dang mthun pa bcu gnyis so/

/ de'i tshe ye shes kyi sku la sangs rgyas zhes btags so/ /de las gzhan pa'i mos spyod kyi sa bcu yang yod do/ /'phags pa'i sa bcu dang*/ mos spyod kyi sa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa ste bcu gnyis ni/ lam 'di'i sa'o cog sa bcu gnyis su sdud pa rgyud las 'byung zhing mkhan po rnams kyis kyang bshad do/ /don dam pa'i so so rang gi rig pa thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ba ni dang por byang chub yan lag mthong ba'i lam mo/ /'di la dga' ba'i rang bzhin bden pa bcu drug dag go /slob pa'i zung 'jug rnam pa dgu ni sa lhag ma dgu'o/ /sa bcu tsam dang*/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes dag las rnam grol lam dang*/ khyad par lam ni sa bcu gnyis sam bcu gsum ste/ yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i ye shes gong ma'i gzhir gyur pa'o/ /'di dag ni sgom pa'i lam 'phags lam yan lag brgyad do/ /mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ni mthar phyin pa'o/ /man ngag las ni thog mar rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang*/ gzhan yang sna tshogs par 'chad do/ /de dag la ni rim pa mi 'dra ba dag 'byung ste/ gal te sbyor ba'i lam du zhugs na ni bye brag med pa kho na'o/ /mos pas spyod pa dang*/ lhag pa'i bsam pa dag pa la spyod pa/ mtshan ma la spyod pa drug dang*/ mtshan ma med pa la spyod pa bdun dang*/ mngon par 'du byed pa med par spyod pa gsum la sogs pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la spyod pa dang*/ yon tan brgya phrag bcu la sogs pa ni thams cad du mdo'i sde bzhin te/ 'on kyang 'dir ni tshe gzhan du ma gyur pa kho na yin gyi skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'ang ma yin na/ bskal pa mang po ni lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de'i phyir dus myur ba kho nas rdo rje sems dpas yang dang yang du ma bstan no/ /gzhan dag ni rang rang gi man ngag nyid du rnam par bzhag gi 'dir mi brjod do/ /'dir smras pa/ grangs nges mtshan nyid go rim nges pa dang*/ /nges tshig yon tan sbyangs bya 'bras bu dang*/

/rten dang shes bya spang bya nyams len tshad/ /dbye bsdu 'di rnams rim pa kun la sbyar/ /phung khams khams gsum 'dus byas rdzas yod dang*/ /kun rdzob yod dang lus sems rten gyi khyad/ /blau rigs rten 'brel zag med rab dbye bcu/ /rim pa gnyis kyi khyad par gzhan yang ni/ /btags pa dang ni mngon sum gyur pa'i lha/ /rags dang phra ba'i sngags dang rig 'dzin gnyis/ /las dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i khyad par dang*/ /sngags dang ye shes sku zhes rnam par phye/ /tha mal bag chags dngos su gnon dang 'joms/ /rtog pa'i srid dang snang ba'i srid 'joms dang*/ /las dang ye shes sgrib sel rnam shes dang*/ /ye shes kyis rab phye dang dngos grub gnyis/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /rgyud kyi sbyor pa gang zhe na/ las kyi rgyud dang*/ dngos grub kyi rgyud do/ /de la las kyi rgyud gang zhe na/ khyad par bcu'am/ brgyad de/ phyogs dus lha dang cha byad bsam pa dang*/ /gnas dang yul dang zas dang cho ga sngags/ de yang bzhi ste/ bsam gtan gyi las dang*/ sbyin sreg gi las dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi las dang*/ sbyor ba'i las phal pa'o/ /de kho na ltar dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ 'on kyang dam tshig gi khyad par dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzas ni lhag pa'o/ /las ni las chen bcu gnyis la sogs pa'o/ /dngos grub kyi rgyud ni gnyis te/ /thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub bo/ /thun mong gi dngos grub gang zhe na/ rdzas kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ lus dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ gzugs med par 'gro ba'o/ /dang ba dang*/ mkha' lding dang*/ khyu mchog sogs bzhon pa dang*/ rin po che sna bdun dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma la sogs pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyi mtshon cha dang*/ yi ge dang*/ ming gi sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa dang*/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/

srin po la sogs pa bsgrubs pas gzhan la brten pa'i dngos grub mtha' yas pa yod do/ /'di las che long tsam bsdus pa ni/ chung ngu ni brgyad de ril bu mig sman dngos grub dang*/ sa 'og ral gri dngos grub dang*/ mkha' la 'phur dang mi snang dang*/ /shi ba med dang nad 'joms so/ /'bring ni 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa phal pa'o/ /chen po ni tshe dang*/ longs spyod la sogs pa bskal pa drug pa dpag tu med pa 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dngos grub gnyis kar spyod pa bsgrub pa yin te/ thun mong dang mchog gi bsnyen pa la zhi gnas dang*/ lhag mthong grub pa na'o/ /de la spyod pa gang zhe na/ gang zag dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ dus dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ nges tshig dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ cho ga'o/ /de la dbye ba gang zhe na/ spros bcas dang*/ spros med dang*/ shin tu spros med dang*/ yang na gnyis spangs dang*/ kun bzang dang*/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ yang na 'dod 'jug dang*/ rten slob dang*/ rig pa brtul zhugs dang*/ yang na res 'jog dang*/ mnyam por spyod pa dang*/ mnyam bzhag dang*/ rjes thob dang*/ chags bral dang*/ chags can dang*/ 'dod chags chen po'o/ /de yang sgom bsam dang*/ dus dang*/ bya ba dang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas spyod pa gsum du bzhag go /smras pa/ gnas dang phyag rgya'i grangs dbye ba/ mtshan nyid cha lugs khyad par ro/ /cho ga dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ spyod tshul dang*/ dbang po sbyangs ma sbyangs dang*/ gnas skabs dang*/ rang bzhin gyi sgo nas de rnams su dbye'o/ /'di dag ni brjod par bya ba mang ngo*/ /mchog gi dngos grub gang zhe na/ 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /sdom ni/ khyad par ngo bo dpe rnams dang*/ /de yi rig 'dzin gyi khyad dang*/ /rig 'dzin zung 'jug yon tan dang*/ /sku dang ye shes nye rgyu'i tshul/ /'bras bu'i rgyud gang zhe na/ dngos dang btags pa'o/ /dngos ni rdo rje 'chang chen po'o/ /btags pa ni sgyu ma'i sku dang*/

zung 'jug gi sems can no/ /'di gnyis dri ma can dang*/ dri ma med pa'i ye shes kyi sku ste/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'ja' lus zhes brjod kyi khams gsum pa ma yin no/ /rdo rje sku'i dpe bcu gnyis gang zhe na/ sgyu ma chu zla mig yor smig sgyu dang*/ /rmi lam brag cha mig 'phrul dri za'i grong*/ /'ja' tshon glog dang chu bur me long gzugs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa gang zhe na/ 'di ni khyad par bdun dang ldan te/ ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa dang*/ mngon shes lnga dang ldan pa dang*/ zhing sna tshogs su 'gro ba'i don spyod pa dang*/ 'dod cing 'chums pa med pa dang*/ 'dod pa mtha' yas pa la bde ba chen por spyod pa dang*/ tshe tshad las brgal ba dang*/ yid kyi lus so/ /'dir rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ ye shes kyi sku la khyad par ci/ phung po'i za ma tog ma nyams pa ni ye shes kyi sku tsam mo/ /las sam ting nge 'dzin gyis nyams pa de'i tshe rig pa 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi sku zhes bya'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyang*/ yon tan brgyad tshan gnyis te bcu drug dang ldan pa'o/ /zung 'jug gi yon tan gang zhe na/ ro myang brgyad dang*/ dbang phyug brgyad dang*/ kha sbyor bdun dang*/ yon tan brgyad ces bya ba ste/ /rtag pa dang ni mi gdung dang*/ /bsil ba dang ni gcig pa dang*/ /bde ba dang ni dri med dang*/ /dga' ba dang ni yid dang ba/ /sku yi dbang phyug dang ni gsung gi dbang phyug dang*/ /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro gnas kyi dbang phyug dang*/ /ci 'dod byed dang yon tan brgyad pa'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ /gzugs phra reg pa yang ba dang*/ /khyab pa yang dag thob pa nyid/ /rab tu gsal ba nyid bstan pa/ /dbang phyug nyid dang 'dod dgur bsgyur/ /gzhan yang byang chub kyi phyogs dang tshad med dang*/ dbang bcu dang*/

stobs bcu dang*/ shes pa bcu dang*/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang*/ mi 'jigs pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa med pa dang*/ smon nas mkhyen pa dang*/ thugs rje chen po dang*/ zad par dang*/ zil gnon dang*/ rnam thar la sogs pa'ang bshad par bya mod kyi/ de dag ni sde snod gsum gyi tshul las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /sde snod 'dir yang mtshan yang dag pa la sogs par bshad do/ /sku gang zhe na/ chos dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ sprul pa dang*/ bde ba chen po dang*/ sku bcu drug la sogs pa dang*/ rdo rje rnam pa bzhi yongs su mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /chos kyi sku gang zhe na/ de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gang zhe na/ kha sbyor gyi yan lag bdun mthar thug pa gcig tu gyur pa chos thams cad la rdzogs par spyod pa'o/ /de yang brda dang don no/ /brda ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mngon sum du gyur pa'o/ /don ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kho na te/ sems can la snang ba ni med do/ /sprul pa'i sku gang zhe na/ brda dang don no/ /brda ni so so'i skye bo 'ga' zhig la yang mngon sum du snang ba'o/ /don ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bya ba bsgrubs pa'i ye shes thugs rje chen po'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sku gang zhe na/ sems can gyi rang bzhin bde ba chen po dang*/ ro myang brgyad dang ldan pa don dam par spros pa dang bral ba gang yin pa ste/ 'di yang chos kyi sku zhes bya'o/ /dbang phyug brgyad ni sku bzhi ka yang bsdus par rig par bya'o/ /sku bcu drug gang zhe na/ bzhi po de dag thugs dang*/ gsung dang*/ sku dang*/ ye shes kyis phye bas bcu drug ste/ rlung dang rdul dang khu ba dang rnam par shes pa dag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi gdung ba med pa dang*/ rdo rje snying rjes sems can sgrol ba dang*/ bde ba chen po zung 'jug gi rang bzhin no/ /de yang yang na gnyis su med pa dang*/

g.yo ba med pa dang*/ ris med pa dang*/ 'dod pa dang*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba dang*/ 'dod chags chen po dang*/ dngos po dang dngos med zad pa dang*/ ye shes dang*/ sems pa dang*/ kun tu bzang po dang*/ nyon mongs med pa dang*/ nyon mongs chen po dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems 'dzin pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje dang*/ thabs shes kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /yang na mnyam pa nyid dang*/ yid kyi gzugs gnyis snang spangs pa dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las dang*/ bag chags spangs pa zhes pa ni sku bzhi'i don no/ /'dir tshigs su bcad pa yang bshad pa/ sprul pa yi ni sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa dang*/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa dang*/ /dpal ldan chos kyi sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa dang*/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa ni/ /sad rmi gnyid sdug bzhi pa yi/ /dbang po gnyis skyes bde min zhing*/ / zhes 'byung ba'o/ /ye shes gang zhe na/ lnga'am bdun no/ /lnga ni me long lta bu dang*/ mnyam pa nyid dang*/ so sor rtog pa dang*/ bya ba sgrub pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /bdun gang zhe na/ zab pa'i ye shes dang*/ rgya che ba dang*/ khyab pa dang*/ rtag pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ sku dang*/ zung 'jug rnams so/ /zab pa gang zhe na/ rang bzhin med pa dang*/ rang rig pa dang*/ 'phel ba dang*/ bri ba med pa dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ gsal bar snang ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /rgya che ba gang zhe na/ bsod nams dang*/ ye shes dang*/ yul dang*/ dmigs pa dang*/ 'jug pa dang*/ 'phṛn las rgya che ba'i mtshan nyid do/ khyab pa gang zhe na/ yul thams cad dang*/ dus thams cad dang/ rgyud gsum la khyab pa dang*/ stong pa nyid dang*/ mnyam pa nyid kyis khyab pa'i mtshan nyid do/ rtag pa gang zhe na/ rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*/ 'gog pa med pa dang*/

rdul phra rags kyi mtshan nyid med pa dang*/ sngon dang phyi mar mi 'gyur pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /bde ba gang zhe na/ kha sbyor chen po dang*/ rang bzhin bde ba dang*/ snying rje gsum dang*/ yid dang rlung thim dang*/ zhu ba dang*/ 'dzag med kyi mtshan nyid do/ /rdo rje'i sku gang zhe na/ stong pa las skyes pa dang*/ sdug bsngal 'gog pa dang*/ gar yang phyin pa dang*/ go 'phang mi g.yo ba dang*/ yid kyi lus dang*/ rlung gi lus dang*/ skad cig la thams cad sprul pa dang*/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyi mtshan nyid do/ /zung 'jug gang zhe na/ gnyis chos med pa dang*/ yang dag min rtog med pa dang*/ rang bzhin la zhugs pa dang*/ snang ba med pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ nam yang mi g.yo ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /nye rgyu gang zhe na/ mchog gi dngos grub la dang por dngos su reg pa dang*/ mthar thug par dngos su reg pa dang*/ gnyis kar rgyud mar reg pa'o/ /dang po ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi yang dag par dbang bskur ba las byung ba'i spyod pa'i ye shes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ longs spyod rdzogs pas dbang bskur ba'i'o/ /gsum pa rig ma'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa thams cad de/ de yang tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar bya ste/ chu dang*/ cod pan la sogs pa gsang ba'i dbang gi bar du sbyin nas/ nyi ma dmar thag chad pa na shes rab ye shes sbyin te rig ma dang lhan cig tho rangs mngon par byang chub pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang*/ rdo rje nyi ma nub nas ni/ /sgrub pa kun tu brtsams par bya/ /skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su ni/ /sgom pa mchog ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ni re zhig lung ngo*/ /'di la dang po dang tha ma la ni phyag rgya gsum ka yang yod do/ /bar ba la ni las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ phyag rgya chen po kho na yod do/ /tha ma kho na bde chen gyi lam la ni/ de dag phyag rgya chen po kha na'o/ /rgyud gsum gyi rim pa phye ba ste gnyis pa'o/

/rjod byed kyi rgyud bshad par bya ste/ rgyud ni du/ dbye ba ni gang*/ mtshan nyid ni gang zhe na/ rgyud ni gnyis dang gnyis dang bzhi dang lnga ste/ dang po ni bya ba dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ de yang gnyis gnyis te bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'o/ /de dag kyang tsam po dang*/ khyad par can gyi dbye ba ste/ mi dang mi'i rgyal po zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bya ba'i rgyud ni drug go /spyod pa ni gsum mo/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni gnyis sam lnga'o/ /bla na med pa ni gnyis so/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na/ gang dang gang gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sngags gtso bor 'byung ba de dag go /rgyud lnga ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ phyi ma dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ cha mthun dang*/ 'phros pa'i rgyud do/ /yang gnyis ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bsdus pa'o/ bzhi ni mdo sde dang*/ rtog pa dang*/ cho ga zhib mo dang*/ gzungs zhes pa'o/ /lam ni rgyas la sngags dang sbyor ba nyung ba ni mdo sde'o/ /cha shas kyi rtog pa ni rtog pa'o/ /thams cad kyi rtog pa ni cho ga zhib mo'o/ /sngags tsam ni gzungs so/ /ci'i phyir rgyud dag tu bzhag ce na/ thabs kyi rgyud bzhin don dang tshig tu 'brel ba dang*/ sgrub pa po nas slob dpon dang*/ slob ma dang dbang dang*/ dam tshig dang*/ sngags dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos grub rnams 'brel zhing rgyun chags pa'i phyir ro/ /bya dang rnal 'byor gtso bo'i phyir/ /rgyud gnyis dang ni nang yang sbyod/ /rnal 'byor rab kyi phul gyur pas/ /rgyud bzhi ru ni rab tu bsgrags/ /'dod chags bzhi lam du byed pa yang yin mod kyi/ de ni sgra don dang 'jog byed kyang yin zhes zer ro/ /rnal 'byor bla med dang*/ rnal 'byor bla ma dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po dang*/ gnyis med kyi rgyud ces pa yang phal cher rnam grangs so/ /bla na med pa'i rgyud gang zhe na/ zhu ba dang*/ rang bzhin gyi bde stong gnyis su med pa ston pa gang yin pa ste/

de'i phyir 'di kho nas skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas sbyin par byed do/ /dbye ba gang zhe na/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /bu ni bu mo dang*/ bu pho'i dbye gzhi ste/ 'on kyang bu ni pho kho na la brjod pa ltar rnal 'byor gyi rgyud do/ /gang du rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sngags dang*/ sbyor ba rgyas pa de ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ sbyor ba kho na rgyas pa de ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud do/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ngo bos ni thams cad kyang dbye ba med do/ /don 'di ma rtogs par phyogs 'dir mkhas pa dang*/ mi mkhas pa dag kha cig ni cha chung dus dbye bar 'dod/ kha cig ni rnam grangs du mar byed/ gzhan dag don bzang po rlom pa dag gis dbye bar 'dod de/ ma nges pa kho na smra'o/ /rgyud kyi gnas lnga gang zhe na/ sdom ni/ las rim dngos grub dam tshig sdom/ /ting 'dzin rgyud kyi sbyor ba'o/ /las kyi rim pa ni dpag tu med de/ de las che long che long bsdus pa ni/ de nyid bcu phyi yi dang*/ gsang ba'i de nyid bcu'o/ /yang na bcu gcig ste/ sdom ni/ sa chog sgrub dang mchod pa dang*/ /sbyin sreg dbang bskur rab gnas dang*/ /yo byad dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang*/ /tshogs 'khor bsnyen pa las tshogs so/ /yo byad ni rdo rje dang*/ dril bu dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ rgyan dang de dag la sogs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid ni bri ba dang*/ bslang ba dang*/ lus dang*/ bsam gtan no/ /sngags kyi stobs las bsod nams 'phel tshul dang*/ /bde bas stong pa rtogs pa'i tshul mchog dang*/ /bde dang myur dang thabs mkhas khyad par dang*/ /bslab gsum nyon mongs lam sbyod 'bras bu'i tshul/ /dmigs pa dam tshig rgyud gzhan bskul ba yis/ /lam 'dir khyad par 'phags par kun gyis bshad/ /bcu gcig po 'di gzhan la yod ma yin/

/'di gnyis byang chub mchog la khyad par ming*/ /ces pa ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /rjod byed kyi rim par phye ba ste gsum pa'o// sgom pa'i tshul gang zhe na/ bskyed pa'i rim pa ni so sor bya'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'di ltar sgom ste thog mar snying gar dhū tī'i nang du nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su hūṃ bsgom mo/ /yang na nor bu zhu ba'i thig le dmar skya yung 'bru tsam bsgom mo/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams su yi ge'am/ thig le bsgoms pas rlung bzlog cing*/ mngon shes kyang 'grub bo zhes so/ /de ltar lte ba'i gtum mo spar te spyi bo'i haṃ zhu ste snying ga'am lte bar 'bar 'dzag bsgom mo/ /gzhan yang ril 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gis 'od gsal du 'jug go /gtum mo ni gsum ste/ las dang rnal 'byor dang rang bzhin gyi gtum mo'o/ /gal te bskyed rim so sor sgom mi nus na/ bsnyen pa la sogs pa spyi'i cho gas bya'o/ /rim par phye ba 'di ni shin tu mang po'i man ngag so so las rtogs par 'gyur bas 'dir mi bri'o/ /bsgom pa'i rim par phye ba ste bzhi pa'o/ /rgyud bshad pa'i thabs gang zhe na/ 'di la bya ba dang rnal 'byor phyi la ni dgos pa'i don dang*/ bsdus pa'i dang*/ tshig gi don dang*/ mtshams sbyor dang*/ brgal lan gyi sgo nas dang*/ gleng gzhi dang*/ gtam gyi sbyor ba ni sngon byung dang*/ rjes 'jug gi dbye bas bshad do/ /re re tsam ni mtha' drug gis bshad de/ de skad du thams cad zos shing kun byas kyang*/ /'grub 'gyur nyes pas mi gos na/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa la ni rgyan bdun dang*/ de'i gtam gyi sbyor ba la ni/ sngon byung dang*/ rjes 'jug dang*/ rgyud 'ga' zhig la ni phyi dang gsang ba de bzhin nang*/ /de bzhin nyid don rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes dang*/ phyi dang*/ nang dang*/ gzhan dang*/ brton pa bzhir bshad pa dag go /shin tu sbas pa'i rgyud la ni tshul bzhi'o/

/mtha' drug ni thams cad la ste/ nges pa dang drang don la lhag ma bzhi bzhis phye bas brgyad do/ /de bzhin du gzhan la yang ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod do/ /tshul bzhir 'chad pa med pa la ni tshogs dang*/ slob ma'i dbye ba med do/ /yi ge gsang chen du bshad pa ni yi ge'i don ma yin zhes kho bo smra'o/ /tshig gcig don gcig gam gnyis su ston pa ni mtha' drug dang*/ don rnam grangs du ma ni tshul bzhis 'chad do/ /de yang mtha' gcig tu ni ma yin te/ spyi'i don nyid gsum mam bzhi la sogs par bshad pa yang yod de/ de dag la rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas bshad pa la sogs man ngag yod par yang 'dod do/ /gal te tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas rgyud mnyan par bya'o/ /de la slob dpon dang*/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid shes pas brtags nas blangs la dbang bskur ba nod par bya'o/ /dam tshig dang*/ sdom pa la gnas pas/ rim pa gnyis la zhib mor mkhas par byas la rgyud mnyan no/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yang sgom pa dang*/ gtor ma yang sbyin pa dang*/ thams cad dkyil 'khor du bltas la/ slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa' la yon dang*/ maṇ+ḍal byas la/ sngon byung ji lta bar sgom pa ni/ slob dpon slob ma gnyis kas so/ /lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ sems kyi skyon bcu gcig spangs te/ de dag gang zhe na/ nyal ba la sogs pa lus kyi gnas ngan len dang*/ rtsed mo dang kyal ka dang*/ zhe sdang ba'i brgal lan dang*/ ca co dang*/ ha cang rtog ge la dga' bas gtan tshigs dang thal 'gyur gyi rnam gzhag thal ba dang*/ man ngag med pa dang*/ rdzun gyi man ngag dang*/ ma smin pa'i skyes bos thos pa dang*/ 'gran pa dang*/ rnyed pa'i sems so/ /gzhan yang smra ba'i rgyun dang ldan pas brjod de/ rnal 'byor la ni mi g.yeng bas 'chad pa dang*/ mnyan pa la ni rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams lhag par yang gzigs so/ /rgyud bshad thabs kyi rim par phye ba ste lnga pa'o// bstan bcos 'di'i ming ci/

las dang po la phan pa'i rab tu byed pa zhes bya'o/ /'di ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i ma mo'i snying po bsdus pa yin te/ sngags kyis gtan la dbab pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /'di dag rgya che bar bla ma'i ngag las rig par bya'o/ /de ci rig pa 'dzin pa'i theg pa yang shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod de/ mngon pa ni bar bar dag las bsdu bar bya dgos so/ kha cig 'di ni gtso bo yin te de'i phyir sde snod gsum du mi bsdu'o/ /zhes pa ni 'thad par mi snang ste/ dper na brgya byin ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gtso bo yin la/ de ni brgya byin ma yin no/ /zhes brjod do/ /de ltar na 'di yang chos yang dag par bsdud pa gtan la dbab pa ste/ 'di kho na bzung bas kyang sngags kyi theg pa'i brda rnams la rmongs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di'i dge ba yang*/ skye ba 'di kho na la rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'gro ba la phan pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /las dang po pa la phan pa'i rab tu byed pa rdzogs so/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam las chos kyi rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin brnyes pa rje btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug gu ru lho phyogs pa'i zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru la spyi bos reg pa tā ra nā tha kun dga' snying pos sngaun med pa'i gtam bzang po dag las ci rigs par rang lo nyer gsum pa'i dang po nag po'i nya la gnas ri bo mthon po'i mgul bsam gtan sdings su thun gsum la myur bar sbyar ba'o// //zhus dag/ //maṅgal bistāraṃ//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i rab tu byed pa bstan pa'i nor rdzas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 154 -- PAGE 155 - - PAGE 126 -
